banner.title: Welcome to LIGOR
banner.description: Liver Cancer Geospatial Omics Resource (LIGOR) is a comprehensive database designed to characterize the spatial intra-tumor heterogeneity(sITH) of hepatocellular carcinoma based on multi-omics data collected from spatially informed tumor sectors. It enables the exploration of multi-omic information across cohorts, characterizing spatial and temporal patterns of molecular changes, facilitating the discovery of biomarkers of clinical relevance.

search.placeholder: Search for mutated gene names, TP53, CTNNB1 AXIN1, etc.

driverLandscape.title: Driver Landscape
driverLandscape.description: Oncoprint plot shows genetic alterations in driver genes (or genes of interests from the user) across samples and patients.

timingAnalysis.title: Timing Analysis
timingAnalysis.description: Timing analysis allows users to trace the timing of the mutated genes by mapping them onto the phylogenetic tree.

differentialExpressionAnalysis.title: Differential Expression Analysis
differentialExpressionAnalysis.description: Differential gene expression analysis discovers differentially expressed genes (DEGs) between different subgroups (e.g. grouping by clinical information or molecular features) of samples.

transcriptomicHeterogeneity.title: Transcriptomic Heterogeneity
transcriptomicHeterogeneity.description: This module explores how transcriptomic subtypes distribute across spatial samples within and between patients.

microenvironmentDeconvolution.title: Transcriptomic Heterogeneity
microenvironmentDeconvolution.description: Microenvironment deconvolution aims to characterize the immune or stroma cell distribution and classify the tumor microenvironment within and between tumors.

microenvironmentSpatialHeterogeneity.title: Microenvironment spatial heterogeneity
microenvironmentSpatialHeterogeneity.description: This module explores how the tumor microenvironment subtypes vary across spatial samples within and between patients.

survivalAnalysis.title: Survival analysis
survivalAnalysis.description: In this module, using existing or user-specified biomarkers, users can explore how biomarkers can stratify patient survival.

multiModalJointAnalysis.title: Multi-modal joint analysis
multiModalJointAnalysis.description: This module allows multi-modal information to be jointly displayed and analyzed.

geospatialAnalysis.title: Geospatial analysis
geospatialAnalysis.description: Visualize multi-modal heterogeneity of molecular features within and between a large group of HCC patients.

temporalAnalysis.title: Temporal analysis
temporalAnalysis.description: Timing multi-modal changes by mapping them onto the phylogenetic tree.

customAnalysis.title: Custom analysis
customAnalysis.description: Support user-defined subgrouping analysis in gene expression, biomarker and survival analysis.

aboutHccPlatform.title: LIGOR
aboutHccPlatform.description: Integrating geospatial and temporal multi-omic information to provide a comprehensive platform, accelerating precision medicine in hepatocellular carcinoma.
